title: Canary and rollback
labels: DETERMINISTIC FIXTURE PROVIDER — scripted workers in real processes; no model was run
SYNTHETIC DATA — every request, team, dataset and value is invented
INJECTED REGRESSION — a traffic shift toward a case class no evaluation set contained

steps.claim: A qualified candidate is activated only in a bounded development canary
steps.observed: canary of 2 synthetic missions; new mission pinned to r2; the earlier mission stays on r1; default release still r1
second mission took the last canary place; the next one got r1

steps.claim: Monitoring on fresh cases finds nothing wrong at first
An injected regression is measured, not asserted
steps.observed: INJECTED: later traffic contains a kind of safe change no evaluation set had. accuracy_drop_vs_approval=0.1333 against a limit of 0.05
active release r1; r2 marked rolled_back; new work is pinned to r1

steps.claim: Missions, artifacts and memories that depended on the rolled-back version are identified
steps.observed: 2 missions (review_ready; planning, in flight), 12 artifacts, 4 memories

steps.claim: None of them is silently kept
steps.observed: artifacts marked needs_revalidation; memories invalidated with the reason "rollback of r2"

steps.claim: Migration of in-flight work is a deliberate, visible decision
steps.observed: one decision opened for the chief of staff about the in-flight mission: repin_and_redo or finish_quarantined
